name: Bloodmage Eternal tank threat audit: the health-cost spellmod misses most of the health-cost kit
contract: Eternal Curse's Tank Stance Aura 807736 effect 2 (aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 2 SPELLMOD_THREAT, +50%) carries SpellClassMask bits matching only Ravenous Strike 500123, Lunge 500126, Rotclaw 503476/804197, Sanguine Rupture 572907/800774 and Taldaram's Torment 800772 (family 26). Every one of those is PowerType Health (-2). Hematoma 803392 is also PowerType Health (-2), family 26, a direct-damage Shadow nuke with no spell_threat row and no classmask bit this aura targets, and -- unlike Blood Blast 500546 -- it carries no CasterAuraSpell/ExcludeCasterAuraSpell restriction, so it stays castable while the stance (which only exists inside Cursed Form 800157) is active: with the stance active, Ravenous Strike (matched) must show a materially higher threat_per_damage than Hematoma (unmatched), even though both 'cost health' per the tooltip. Blood Blast was dropped from this scenario: its ExcludeCasterAuraSpell is 802877, the Cursed Form marker 800157's OnAuraApply also casts, so Spell::CheckCast (src/server/game/Spells/Spell.cpp:5926-5927) always refuses it with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE while any Cursed Form -- including the tank stance -- is active; it can never be compared against the stance at all, so it was not a valid representative of the classmask gap despite report B listing it. Hemorrhagic Shock 504702 carries the same 802877 exclusion and has the same problem; Bloodmoon Blast/Valanar's Vengeance exclude a different marker (524861, a non-Eternal Cursed Form) and remain castable here. Blood Howl 800782 (aura 11 MOD_TAUNT, implicit target 22 AoE around caster) must still apply its taunt aura to a nearby enemy.

steps.label: OK: Ravenous Strike (classmask-matched) gets the extra 50% threat on top of the stance
Clear the shared GCD (category 133) left by Ravenous Strike before the next cast
WRONG: Hematoma also costs health but is missed by the same classmask, same gap as Blood Blast
Clear the shared GCD left by Hematoma before the next cast
OK: Blood Howl's AoE taunt applies to a nearby enemy
